## Scenario and evidence

Describe the recurring problem using synthetic or public-safe material.

## Proposed rule

State the reusable rule, its smallest owning file, applicability, and exceptions.

## Alternatives and verification

Explain the alternatives considered, affected artifacts, and a way to verify the rule.
The maintainer decides whether the proposal becomes a shared rule.
